violated_contract: An explicit calendar instruction must survive short-clip cost-thinning and later relevance gates so normal downstream adjudication can assess it. A reminder-only exemption must not send a direct put-on-calendar or add-content-to-calendar instruction to an empty deterministic minimum.
canonical_prevention: Use one bounded segment-level keep instruction guard across short-clip admission, deterministic relevance, content classification and minimum salience. Preserve existing reminder, authority and privacy contracts; test false rollback, non-instruction controls and the production notes boundary without directly authorizing an event or action.
